Callout.Name: Factory Fire
Callout.Message: Fire at a factory unit, staff evacuating.
Callout.Advisory: Rolling doors open, smoke across the yard.

Script.Line: Everybody is out. We counted them at the gate.
It is in the paint store. That is the one that frightens me.
There is a man unaccounted for. He was on the mezzanine.

Lines.Approach: A working factory, staff coming out, and whatever is in there is burning hot.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
